thesis: This episode argues that effective CEOs must master the art of delegation to scale their organizations, drawing lessons from companies that successfully navigated near misses to achieve growth. It emphasizes that building a culture where delegation is taught and practiced is essential for long-term success, even when facing external pressures or internal concerns.
